answers.question: Should `--expand-alias` on an alias whose anchor is flow-style (e.g. `&d {model: opus}`) convert the copy to block style, or refuse?
answers.reply: Convert it. The contract says `set --expand-alias PATH VALUE` replaces the alias with a block-style copy of the anchored node, so the copy is written in block style whatever style the anchor uses. Nothing else changes, so the anchored node itself stays as it is.
